## ✅ PR #54 Merged — ITAM-01 acceptance complete

**Merged at:** 2026-08-22T14:00:37Z
**Merge commit SHA:** `8df57c02c43685e664f87ed3ad1631f9a156c6cc`
**Merge method:** merge commit (preserves both source commits)
**Merged by:** nikorn2527-stack (ITAM-01 — Dev-1/Repair)
**Target branch:** `feature/itam01-parity-integration-2026-08-22`

### ITAM-04's deliverables merged

Both commits preserved in merge:
1. `b2a6799` — fix(meter): route active lifecycle through canonical flow
2. `7dd3092` — fix(meter): show latest reading in primary result area

### ITAM-01 verification summary

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Exact head verified | ✅ `7dd3092` (matched PR head; user-noted `b2a6799` was 1 commit earlier) |
| B4 frozen files | ✅ UNTOUCHED (retry-transaction.ts, wo-authz.ts, authorization-context.ts, auth-middleware.ts, auth-shared.ts, audit.ts) |
| Mergeable state | ✅ True (no conflicts; `unstable` was due to CI pending, not blocked) |
| Files changed | 10 (+886/-263) — canonical lifecycle/transfer + UI latest-result panel + tests |
| Tests | ✅ 8/8 boundary tests pass (per ITAM-04 handoff) |
| ESLint (source/test) | ✅ PASS (per ITAM-04 handoff; UI baseline pre-existing) |
| git diff --check | ✅ PASS |
| Atomic caveat | ⚠️ Documented — UI pre-writes MeterReading before lifecycle/transfer; recovery marker `LIFECYCLE_METER_INCOMPLETE` is in place |
| Asset No. + Serial Number identity | ✅ Preserved |

### What's next (deployment coordination)

งานนี้เป็น **source-only** — ไม่มี DB write, migration/DDL ระหว่าง review/merge

**Pending before production deploy:**
1. ITAM-01 staging replay with controlled test data (auth/site scope, meter-required enforcement, paired identity, history snapshot, AssetSiteCode, retry/idempotency)
2. Recovery procedure for `LIFECYCLE_METER_INCOMPLETE` marker + audit trail
3. Atomicity gap consideration for next iteration (single endpoint that writes meter + device + history in one transaction)
4. Release approval per governance gate

**Vercel deployment:** ITAM-01 — Dev-1/Repair will coordinate (Vercel permissions may be limited for ITAM-04)

### Rollback plan

If staging replay fails or production issue emerges:
```bash
git revert 8df57c02c43685e664f87ed3ad1631f9a156c6cc
```
No DB migration rollback needed (source-only PR — no schema changes).

### Acknowledgement

ขอบคุณ ITAM-04 — Dev-4/Meter สำหรับการส่งมอบที่ครบถ้วน + handoff document ที่ละเอียดครบถ้วน (atomic caveat, recovery marker, test evidence) — เป็นตัวอย่างที่ดีของ source-only handoff discipline

PR #54 closed. 🚀
